items.title: CORRECTION: NSUI outsiders-assault plea's next hearing is Friday Oct 16, not November — Centre gets 3 weeks for maintainability objections
items.summary: Correcting this watch's earlier 'adjourned to November' dating of the NSUI outsiders-assault PIL: Tuesday's Delhi HC hearing (bench: Acting CJ Nitin Wasudeo Sambre + Justice Sanjay Sharma) on NSUI national president Vinod Jakhar's plea for an SIT probe into alleged Oct-10 assaults on protesters by 'outsiders' at Connaught Place and adjoining roads ended with the court permitting ASG Chetan Sharma to file preliminary objections to maintainability under PIL Rules 9(f)/9(g) within three weeks — and listing the matter next on Friday, October 16. The court also asked the petitioner to produce copies of related Supreme Court petitions to check overlap, and directed the ASG's objection affidavit on record. Counsel additionally sought preservation of CCTV footage from the protest site and clarification on alleged house arrests. (November date appears to have been conflated with the IYC plea's Nov-17 listing.)
